absorbed into existing \\u003Cid\\u003E; retired as wrong or obsolete, with its reason; left alone; held out; not reached.\u0022,\u0022The template\\u0027s held-out rule keys on the In prompts line of h9k learn show, and says a lesson recorded on another node of the owner\\u0027s fleet that reaches prompts is an ordinary lesson.\u0022,\u0022The template allows retiring a lesson into an existing live lesson that already states its whole claim with no new lesson recorded, and allows retiring a lesson as wrong or obsolete only when its reason names evidence at the checkout\\u0027s commit (a file and line, or the absence of a named file or symbol).\u0022,\u0022The template states that every claim in a merged lesson appears in at least one lesson it cites, and that a merge longer than its sources together is not recorded because a new merge is the newest lesson and displaces recent ones from the prompt section.\u0022,\u0022The exit criterion no longer lets \\u0027no merge was warranted\\u0027 stand in for the per-lesson account.\u0022,\u0022The held-out sentence in LessonsDocumentRenderer.cs matches LessonProvenanceMark: fleet lessons that reach prompts are not described as held out, and the held-out kinds are named.\u0022,\u0022A test over h9k learn distill\\u0027s rendered draft asserts the six headings and the --limit 500 inventory command appear in it, and any golden or snapshot of the renderer\\u0027s output is updated.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Content\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022The challenge of draft 9c5caf8c (report /Users/brianhallmanac/.hall9k/runs/01a1d1f9-680f-7475-b4ed-e35643a92bef/challenge-report.md) found defects that come from the shipped template .claude/templates/learn-distill/task.md, not from the draft: the earlier distillation 0fe36d3d had the same defects and was fixed by hand. The report\\u0027s section \\u0027Proposed criteria\\u0027 holds the exact replacement criteria and exit criterion; use them, with \\u003Cthis task\\u0027s id\\u003E filled by the template\\u0027s existing substitution. The same imprecise sentence about lessons from another node being held out appears in src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LessonsDocumentRenderer.cs:64-68; LessonProvenanceMark.cs:63,146 lets lessons from the owner\\u0027s own fleet into prompts, and :82,93,97 hold out unknown-node, outside-fleet, and no-provenance lessons.
